items.stem: A beam-tuning model must react every 50 ms. Which component hosts it?
An energy-saving policy updated hourly from KPIs runs where?
Which interface would an rApp's guidance travel over to reach an xApp?
A proposal trains a neural network inside the per-slot scheduler loop. How should a reviewer respond?
choices: Reject the placement; training belongs in the non-RT loop

items.stem: O-RAN documents are used in this course how?
choices: For topic labels and architecture vocabulary only

items.stem: Twin and reference sim disagree by RMSE 0.4 dB. What may the poster claim?
choices: Two models agree closely; calibration remains open

items.stem: Which single change would allow calibrated_claim to become true?
choices: Comparing the twin with real site measurements

items.stem: A twin uses an optimistic clutter model shared with the reference simulator. What risk follows?
choices: Both agree while both miss reality

items.stem: Errors of 0, 0, 0 and 4 dB give what RMSE?
Why does the research spine keep Paper I's calibration gap visible?
choices: So the next cohort knows which measurements to collect

items.stem: Two training positions also appear in the test set. Which validity threat is this?
Results from a LEO S-band scenario are presented as valid for urban mmWave. Which threat?
An apprentice optimises top-1 accuracy while the operator cares about throughput. Which threat?
Which guardrail forbids using captured signals from a private competition?
choices: Synthetic data only applies to figures

items.stem: A slide says 'in partnership with a national lab' with no agreement in place. Which rule is broken?
Which capstone element lets another campus regenerate a figure without contacting you?
choices: Config digest and seed on the figure

items.stem: Why is a capstone packet not a publication?
choices: It has not been submitted or peer reviewed

items.stem: Who decides when a manuscript from the research spine is submitted?
During review a mentor's rerun of one figure gives a different curve. What follows?
choices: The figure is removed until its manifest reproduces

items.stem: Which artifact must never appear in the learner packet?
A 7GC cohort in Geelong wants to reuse Gary's beam figure in a port scenario. What should the ledger say?
choices: The figure is SYNTHETIC_SIM for its own scenario; port transfer is untested

items.stem: Delay at 600 km nadir is 2.0 ms; a user at 20° elevation sees a longer delay. Why?
choices: Slant range is longer than altitude

items.stem: Which pair of results would justify 'the model reduces sweep cost on this scenario'?
choices: High top-3 accuracy and a paired CI excluding zero

items.stem: What is the apprenticeship's final claim boundary?
choices: Synthetic, reproducible, apprentice-scale research — not deployment or credential
